reviews.name: Marya Morrison
reviews.text: Rob has done excellent roof repair and replacement at my Tampa Bay investment properties and home — fair pricing and top-quality work. My go-to licensed roofing contractor.

reviews.name: David Saren
reviews.text: Several roof repairs over the years, each diagnosed fast at reasonable cost. Roof Monsters just finished a full shingle roof replacement and flat deck — professional from start to finish.

reviews.name: Jerry Edmonds
reviews.text: Prompt roofing crew — completed our roof replacement in one day with thorough cleanup. Not a single stray nail left on the property.

reviews.name: Tim Bradshaw
reviews.text: Punctual, thorough, economical roofing contractor. Same crew every job. Passed our 4-point wind inspection with no issues after the work.

reviews.name: Mary Paxton
reviews.text: Fabulous Tampa Bay roofing company — had my roof done in one day. Polite crew, very reasonable pricing. Highly recommend Roof Monsters.
